title: The guard protects the sender, not the recipient
violates: The recipient's balance stays at zero or above, in signed 64-bit arithmetic: `B + X ≥ 0`.
because: The guard bounds the debit and not the credit, so the recipient's balance plus the amount can wrap past the largest 64-bit value and read as negative.
class: an overflow on the credit that the guard on the debit does not see

cured_by.text: Check the credit as well as the debit, use checked arithmetic, or an unbounded type. Until then CL-1.5 names the recipient as not covered.

also.caption: Pyodide, asked a related query (`B ≥ 0, M > 0, B + M < 0`), found a different wrap. A witness is not canonical, so the label checks the property.
